## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

MFSGA/AChimera.body:
# AChimera — Android Client for Chimera Proxy

> Experimental Android client built with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and a Rust proxy core.

## Chimera Ecosystem

```text
Chimera Desktop
       ↕
Chimera Client (Rust client core)
       ↕ VLESS / REALITY
Chimera Proxy Server (Rust server core)
       ↕
AChimera (Android client) · Proxy Wiki
```

- [Chimera](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera) — cross-platform desktop application
- [Chimera Client](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera_Client) — Rust client core
- [Chimera Proxy Server](https://github.com/MFSGA/Chimera_Service) — Rust server core
- [Proxy Wiki](https://mfsga.github.io/Proxy_WIKI/) — documentation and deployment notes

AChimera is an experimental proxy client project based on Android + Kotlin/Jetpack Compose + Rust/UniFFI. The current repository already provides foundational capabilities including the Android UI, VPN service entry point, configuration import and validation, Rust core bridging, log viewing, and a node panel. Its goal is to split the mobile experience and the underlying network core into a clear multi-module structure.
The current application name is `Chimera Lite`. The package contains both the Android UI layer and the Rust core exposed to Kotlin via UniFFI.

## Supported Protocols

- `anytls`
- `hysteria2`
- `reality`
- `shadowsocks`
- `xhttp` (including HTTP/3; requires standard TLS and ALPN `h3`)
- `trojan`
- `vless` (including optional 1-RTT encryption)
- `wireguard`
- `tls+ws`

## Application Architecture

The shared business boundaries, settings data sources, and VPN lifecycle responsibilities of the two UIs are described in [Application Architecture](https://github.com/MFSGA/AChimera/blob/HEAD/ARCHITECTURE.md). …

> Admission is free; laughter is at your own expense.

Four centuries of solemnity have been repeatedly signed for by the same frog, and academia has yet to offer a reasonable explanation.

You may understand this place as an art museum. The difference is that every painting here is laughing, and laughing very politely. They will not suddenly stop when you approach.

OCselected/ttoos.body:
# The Tao of Open Source: Exploring the Ideas, Knowledge, and Value of Open Source!

* **Open source is the way of innovation!**
* **Open source is the way of collaboration!**
* **Open source is the way of democracy!**

The Tao of Open Source promotes open source through writing. Its content covers open source culture, methodology, business, cognition, psychology, a systematic IT project, and more. It aims to spread open source principles, bring the local community closer in step with the world, and respond to a changing world in innovative ways.

## Community

As its influence has grown, the Tao of Open Source has gradually gained recognition, and people with similar views have naturally begun to gather, forming a niche community. Reading, writing articles, recording podcasts, giving talks, holding meetups... The key is that the community drives the production of a certain amount of value.

For communication channels and information publishing, please see the [Community Guide](https://github.com/OCselected/ttoos/blob/HEAD/content/Community/communication.md).

## Why ttoos?

ttoos is the abbreviation of "the Tao of open source," which in Chinese is "开源之道." I suppose I should see this through to the end!

## Why is it under the [OCSelected](http://www.ocselected.org) project?

OCSelected stands for Open Culture Selected, meaning "selected open culture," which is itself the Tao of open source.

## Contributor Guide

If you have a strong interest in open source culture, phenomena, and methodology, feel free to join us and go further together.

For more details on how to actually get things done, please see [How to Contribute to the Tao of Open Source](https://github.com/OCselected/ttoos/blob/HEAD/content/Community/CONTRIBUTING.md).

When your work is accepted, your name will be recorded as follows and widely shared.

autisticryptic/SimMaster.body: # SimAdmin - Multi-Line SIM/eSIM and IMS Management Hub SimAdmin is a web management system for Debian cellular CPE, portable WiFi, and soft-router devices. It models each “baseband + SIM slot” as an independent line, and manages SIM/eSIM, cellular data, SMS, calls, VoLTE, VoWiFi, SIP Trunk, device networking, notifications, and automation within a single service. The project consists of a Rust + Axum backend and a React + TypeScript frontend. By default, the backend manages modems through ModemManager D-Bus, and it also provides an experimental native QMI/MBIM/AT backend that must be explicitly enabled. For the current completion boundaries, see [native backend status](https://github.com/autisticryptic/SimMaster/blob/HEAD/docs/NATIVE_BACKEND_STATUS.md). In production, the same backend process hosts the frontend SPA. By default it is installed to `/opt/simadmin` and runs under systemd. > The current IMS, multi-baseband, and eSIM capabilities are highly dependent on modem firmware, kernel drivers, carrier configuration, and SIM permissions. > “Capability provided in code” does not mean every device can use it directly. Please validate on target hardware using the real-device checklist. ## Core Capabilities - **Multi-line isolation**: device info, SIM, APN, data, roaming, airplane mode, radio/bands, carrier registration, VoLTE, VoWiFi, eSIM, SMS, and voice policies are all addressed and persisted by a stable `line_id`. - **Multi-path IMS**: shares SIP, Digest-AKA, SMS encoding/decoding, and the voice core. VoWiFi uses a built-in IKEv2/ESP-over-ePDG user-space protocol stack, while VoLTE uses a separate IMS bearer and Linux `ip xfrm`. - **Voice and SMS orchestration**: SMS can be ordered and failed over per line across VoWiFi, VoLTE, and CS. IMS voice calls can be routed between VoWiFi and VoLTE. It also includes receive-leg election, cross-channel deduplication, delivery records, and line-level call control. - **SIP Trunk**: bridges a line's voice capabilities to Asterisk and other SIP…

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong Immigration Department smart ID card appointment quota monitoring dashboard: detection every 5 minutes, plus email/Feishu notifications when quotas are released (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Registration of Persons Offices of the Hong Kong Immigration Department, checking about every 2 minutes, and alerts subscribers via email / Feishu group when quotas are released. **This is a third-party public-interest tool, not an official service of the Immigration Department. It only monitors and sends alerts, and does not grab or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard Entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Access to github.io from mainland China is intermittent. jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so do not use them as web entry points.)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is email subscription + Feishu group. The notification pipeline is reachable directly within China, so releases reach your phone right away. The dashboard is only a supplementary aid.

## How It Works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ Fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request per run)
                            │  ├─ Diff against the previous snapshot → release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements Over Similar Tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically by row, so all six offices fit on one screen without horizontally scrolling a table
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Anti-notification-flood:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (measured 304↔346 cells fluctuating within the same minute). The notification layer applies a per-cell cooldown, so it does not alert on every cycle
- **Direct access in mainland China:** email subscription and Feishu notification pipelines are reachable directly within China without circumvention
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer "earliest date available to book"

guaner-334/civ-atlas.description: Generate a complete planet in the browser and simulate its history, yielding an editable map and chronicle. Aimed at original worldbuilding for novels, setting bibles, tabletop RPGs, and similar creative work.
guaner-334/civ-atlas.body:
Generate a complete planet in the browser and simulate its history: compute terrain and ecology from plate tectonics, river erosion, climate, and ocean currents, then simulate peoples, states, wars, and dynastic changes, yielding an editable map and chronicle. Aimed at original worldbuilding for novels, setting bibles, tabletop RPGs, and similar creative work.

**[Use online](https://atlas.gerdor.top)** | [Roadmap](#路线图) | [Development notes](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/blob/HEAD/docs/development.md) | [Report issues](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/issues) | [QQ discussion group 925687934](#反馈与参与)

The website is free to use. Generation, simulation, editing, saving, and export all happen in the browser; no installation or registration is required. Within the same version, the same seed and parameters produce bit-for-bit identical worlds on any device; save files record only the seed, parameters, and edits, and are usually just a few KB.

## Features

### Planet generation

- **Spherical mesh**: spherical Poisson-disk sampling with spherical Delaunay triangulation; about 36,000 irregular cells by default, adjustable up to 200,000. The map wraps east–west, includes both poles, and has no planar seams.
- **Plate tectonics**: plates of widely varying sizes move around Euler poles; convergent boundaries build mountains, subduction zones form trenches, and divergent boundaries form mid-ocean ridges. Generates continents, microcontinents, island arcs, and polar continents.
- **River erosion**: stream power law, solved with the implicit method of Braun & Willett (2013); Priority-Flood fills depressions, and river networks and lakes are derived from drainage calculations.
- **Climate**: temperature is computed from latitude and elevation; the three-cell circulation's wind belts carry moisture downwind, windward slopes receive more rain, and leeward slopes form rain shadows.
- **Ocean currents**: warm currents, cold currents, and coastal upwelling are placed following the patterns of ocean circulation, altering coastal temperature and precipitation.
- **Biomes**: divided into rainforest, grassland, desert, tundra, and so on, by mean annual temperature and annual precipitation (Whittaker diagram).

### Historical simulation

- **Peoples and states**: peoples spread from their origin across habitable land, blocked by mountains, seas, and deserts; they found cities, establish states, expand, wage and negotiate wars, pay tribute or become vassals, form and break alliances, split, merge, restore, and move capitals. States lacking salt, horses, iron, or gold and silver go to war with neighboring provinces across the border that have these resources.
- **Rise and fall**: regions suffer famine, popular uprisings, and plague (plague zones are drawn on the map); great powers that dominate a continent decline and fragment, then are reunified.
- **Court and provinces**: the central court assigns each province direct rule, delegated administration, autonomy, or secession; garrison commanders may become semi-independent and defy orders, and the court can also reclaim them. The "administration" fill shows what fraction of each province is under control.
- **Dynasties and figures**: dynastic succession and genealogies; every ruler and general has a biography (reign years, father and son, predecessor and successor, personal campaigns, fate), and each dynasty has a family tree. Each dynasty also has several chief ministers who, like generals, have courtesy names, places of origin, offices, and a life story; negotiations, regency, and enthronements they handled are recorded in the chronicle.

henjicc/Henji-AI.body:
# Henji AI · Henji-AI

**Use all kinds of AI in one piece of software, bringing image, video, and audio creation together in a single desktop workspace.**

Henji AI is built for creators who repeatedly generate, edit, and organize materials. After connecting your own model provider accounts, you can generate content directly, or connect prompts, reference materials, and generated results in a node canvas to continue with follow-up creation.

[Download the app](#下载应用) · [Quick start](#快速开始) · [Run from source](#从源码运行) · [Model SDK](https://github.com/henjicc/Henji-AI/blob/HEAD/packages/ai-sdk/README.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/henjicc/Henji-AI/issues)

> [!NOTE]
> This document describes the **2.0 development version** on the `main` branch. The current source version is `2.0.0-beta.1`. The public installers are still the older version and do not yet include all the capabilities described below. To try the current version, see 'Run from source'.

## What you can do

- **Generate images, videos, and audio**: In the same interface, choose a provider and model, enter prompts, upload reference materials, adjust parameters, and view task progress and history.
- **Organize creative workflows with a canvas**: Connect text, image, and generation nodes, use the previous step's result as a reference for the next step, and save the work as a project you can keep editing.
- **Edit images**: Crop, rotate, add text, arrows, numbering, and mosaics. You can open it standalone from the toolbox, or process images within the canvas.
- **Create 3D camera references**: Build scenes, place characters and poses, adjust camera angles, and export the frame as a reference image for AI generation.
- **Manage assets**: Import and search materials in the asset library, organize content with tags and collections, and reuse them in your creations.
- **Let the assistant help**: Use the built-in assistant to query content, adjust settings, and operate the canvas. You can also create MCP connection authorizations for external agents so they can access app capabilities according to set permissions.

### Providers and models

Image, video, and audio generation is integrated with services including PPIO (派欧云), Fal, ModelScope (魔搭), KIE, APIMart, Alibaba Cloud Bailian (阿里云百炼), Volcano Engine (火山引擎), Grsai, SiliconFlow (硅基流动), and others. Different providers offer different models and features.

| Image generation and editing | Seedream (即梦), Nano Banana, GPT Image, Qwen Image, Z-Image |
| Video generation | Kling (可灵), Veo, Seedance (即梦), Wan (万相), Hailuo (海螺), Vidu |
| Speech synthesis | MiniMax Speech, CosyVoice, Qwen TTS, Seed-TTS |…

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

shiwenxin123/NetOps-toolkit.body:
# NetOps Toolkit v4.0 - Network Operations Toolkit

A powerful **multi-vendor network device configuration generator** with a modern interface, supporting **Huawei/H3C/Ruijie/Maipu/ZTE switches**, **ZTE ROSNG**, **ZTE OLT**, **DPtech FW1000 firewalls**, and **H3C SecPath load balancers**, with **11+ built-in network tools**, developed with Python + PyQt5.

## What's New in v4.0

### 🎨 Tech-Inspired UI Design
- **Dark gradient theme** - purple-blue gradient background, cyberpunk style
- **Glowing border effect** - neon blue highlights, very high-tech feel
- **Adaptive window** - automatically adapts to different screen sizes
- **Modern controls** - gradient buttons, glassmorphism cards

### 🔄 Multi-Vendor Device Support
- **Huawei** - 248 commands + 8 configuration examples
- **H3C** - 239 commands + 9 configuration examples
- **Ruijie** - 284 commands + 10 configuration examples
- **Maipu** - 229 commands + 8 configuration examples
- **ZTE** - ZXR10 5200/5900/8900 classic ZXROS configuration generation (basic, VLAN, routing, ACL, aggregation)
- **ZTE ROSNG** - ZXR10 5960/9900 next-generation ROSNG configuration generation (VLAN, Access/Trunk, SSH, smartgroup, static routing)
- **ZTE OLT** - ZXA10 C300/C320 and C600 configuration generation (hostname, management address, uplink VLAN, SSH, static routing; ONU registration is comment-only)
- **DPtech FW1000** - firewall Conplat configuration generation (management port, VLAN, security zones, packet filtering, bond)
- **DPtech LSW** - LSW3600/LSW5600 switch Conplat configuration generation (VLAN, Access/Trunk, SSH, bond)
- **H3C Load Balancer (H3C SecPath)** - server load balancing configuration generation (real servers, real server groups, virtual servers, ICMP health checks, static routing)
- One-click device type switching. After selecting "ZTE", generated output uses classic ZXROS. After selecting "ZTE ROSNG", output uses `switchvlan-configuration`, `system-user`, and `gei-0/1/1/1`. After selecting "DPtech FW1000", output uses `conf-mode`, `gige0_1`, and `security-policy`.
